title: From Edgy Art To Ancient Egypt And Understanding Human Perception
description: Can art really be “dangerous”, what causes hallucinations and why are we still fascinated by the ancient Egyptians? The latest instalment of Raworths Salon North explores all this and much more.

title: Ginkgo biloba: an ancient remedy with modern appeal
description: An expert explains why this plant, used in traditional medicine for over 1,000 years, remains one of the world's most popular herbal supplements.

title: Dog days of the Bronze Age: Ancient pup’s paw prints found in 4,000-year-old brick
description: Nearly 4,000 years ago, a dog in western Turkey couldn't resist a fresh mudbrick. Archaeologists have now found the evidence.
